verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Agent apps let teams use partner-built agents directly in their GitHub workflows, powered by the Copilot subscription (docs-18). Tasks can be assigned to third-party agents such as Claude by Anthropic and OpenAI Codex (docs-3), and multiple agents can be tracked and governed from one workspace and control plane (docs-8, docs-23). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how partner agent apps are set up and configured, a list of available partners and integration scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
